questions.question: A waiter's income consists of his salary and tips. During one week, his tips were 5/4 of his salary. What fraction of his income came from tips?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Tips to Salary = 5 : 4

Total Income = Tips + Salary = 5 + 4 = 9 units

Fraction of income from tips = Tips ÷ Total Income = 5/9

**∴ The correct answer is 5/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Tips = 5/4 × Salary

Total Income = Salary + Tips

**Formula:**

Fraction of tips = Tips ÷ (Salary + Tips)

 
 
 Salary (4)
 Tips (5)
 
• 
 Total Income = 9 Units
 Fraction of Tips = 5 ÷ 9

Let Salary = 4x

⇒ Tips = 5/4 × 4x = 5x

⇒ Total Income = 4x + 5x = 9x

⇒ Fraction of income from tips = 5x ÷ 9x

⇒ Fraction = 5/9

**∴ The correct answer is 5/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio to Fraction

If the ratio of two parts A and B is a:b, the fraction of A in the whole (A+B) is a/(a+b) and the fraction of B is b/(a+b).

Percentage Calculation

To convert the fraction of tips into a percentage, multiply by 100. Example: (5/9) × 100 ≈ 55.55%.

Proportion Rule

If A = (m/n) × B, then the ratio A:B is m:n. Here, Tips = (5/4) × Salary, so Tips:Salary = 5:4.</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper earned a profit (in ₹) by selling an item, which is three times the discount offered (in ₹). If the discount offered is 6.25%, what is his profit percentage ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount % = 6.25%

Profit = 3 × Discount

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit)/(Cost Price) times 100 

**Calculation:**

Let MRP = ₹100

Discount = 6.25% of 100 = ₹6.25

Selling Price = 100 - 6.25 = ₹93.75

Profit = 3 × 6.25 = ₹18.75

Cost Price = 93.75 - 18.75 = ₹75

Profit % = (18.75)/(75) times 100 

⇒ Profit % = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: In a parallelogram, one of the parallel sides is 16 cm and the other side is 12 cm. If the perpendicular distance between the two parallel sides of dimension 16 cm is 24 cm, then the perpendicular distance between its other two parallel sides is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of one side = 16 cm.

Length of another side = 12 cm.

Perpendicular height for 16 cm side = 24 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Area of parallelogram = base × height.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad85e032fbf93c56af2f1d3350a977ce3a003c8faf97a3751f74e29281bafad.png] 

Area = 16 × 24.

⇒ Area = 384 cm².

For the 12 cm side, let height = h.

The area also = 12 × h.

⇒ 384 = 12 × h.

⇒ h = 384 / 12.

⇒ h = 32 cm.

**Perpendicular distance between the other two parallel sides = 32 cm.**

questions.question: If a cube of side 45 cm is melted to form a cuboid, then what will be its height of the cuboid if the length of the cuboid is equal to the side of the cube and the width of the cuboid is 22.5 cm? (in cm)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 

A cube of height 45 cm is melted to form a cuboid. The length of the cuboid is equal to the side of the cube, and the width of the cuboid is 22.5 cm.

 

**Formula Used:**

 

Volume of the cube = side³

 

Volume of the cuboid = length × width × height

 

Calculation:

 

Side of the cube = 45 cm

 

Volume of the cube = (45)³ = 45 × 45 × 45 cm³

 

Now,

 

Length of the cuboid = Side of the cube = 45 cm

 

Width of the cuboid = 22.5 cm

 

Let the height of the cuboid be H cm.

 

Volume of the cuboid = 45 × 22.5 × H

 

Since the volume of the cube = volume of the cuboid:

 

⇒ 45 × 45 × 45 = 45 × 22.5 × H

 

⇒ H = (45×45×45)/(45×22.5)

 

⇒ H = 90 cm

 

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Pradeep is 4 years older than his wife Pratibha and the present age of their son is 9 years. If the present age of Pradeep's son is 1/4 times of Pradeep's age and if the couple's son was born after 2 years of their marriage, then find the age of Pradeep's wife at the time of her marriage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pradeep's age = Pratibha's age + 4 

Pradeep's son's present age = 9 years

Pradeep's son's present age = (1/4) × Pradeep's present age

Son was born after 2 years of the couple's marriage

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of Pratibha be x years.

So, the present age of Pradeep = (x + 4) years

According to the question,

Pradeep's son's present age = (1/4) × Pradeep's present age 

⇒ 9 = (1/4) × (x + 4)

⇒ x = 36 - 4

⇒ x = 32 yrs

Again according to the question,

the son was born after 2 years of the couple's marriage

So, Pratibha's age at the time of her marriage = Pratribha's present age - (Son's present age + 2 yrs)

⇒ 32 - (9 + 2)

⇒ 32 - 11

⇒ 21 yrs

**∴ The age of Pradeep's wife at the time of her marriage was 21 yrs.**

questions.question: If the simple interest on ₹7,200 in 3 years at the rate of 16% per annum equals the simple interest on ₹9,600 at the rate of x% per annum in 4 years. The value of x is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the simple interest is equal in both cases, the products of their Principal, Rate, and Time must be equal.

P₁ × R₁ × T₁ = P₂ × R₂ × T₂

7200 × 16 × 3 = 9600 × x × 4

345600 = 38400 × x ⇒ x = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal 1 (P₁) = ₹7,200, Rate 1 (R₁) = 16%, Time 1 (T₁) = 3 years

Principal 2 (P₂) = ₹9,600, Rate 2 (R₂) = x%, Time 2 (T₂) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a34f0a0aaed70e673a953fbccf8f789ea9af1425bf4beb67f0645509d3d496a2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = (7200 × 16 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = (9600 × x × 4) ÷ 100

According to the question, SI₁ = SI₂

⇒ (7200 × 16 × 3) ÷ 100 = (9600 × x × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ 72 × 48 = 96 × 4x

⇒ 3456 = 384x

⇒ x = 3456 ÷ 384

⇒ x = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated strictly on the initial principal amount throughout the entire period. The formula used is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Constant Interest Concept

When the simple interest obtained from two different investments is completely equal, their respective (P × R × T) products must balance out equally.

Amount

The amount refers to the total final sum of the principal and the simple interest earned over the given duration. Formula: A = P + SI = P(1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

questions.question: The average of 48 numbers is 78. If we subtract a number 'X' from each number, then the average becomes 57. What is the value of X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 48 numbers is 78.

New average after subtracting a number 'X' from each number is 57.

**Formula Used:**

New Average = Old Average - X

**Calculation:**

Old Average = 78

New Average = 57

Number of terms = 48

New Average = Old Average - X

⇒ 57 = 78 - X

⇒ X = 78 - 57

⇒ X = 21

**The value of X is 21.**

questions.question: The average age of a group of 20 boys is 25 years. A boy aged 15 years leaves the group. A new boy joins the group and the average age of the group increases by 2 years. What is the age of the new boy?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial average age of 20 boys = 25 years

A boy aged 15 years leaves the group, and a new boy joins. The average increases by 2 years.

**Formula used:**

Sum of ages = Average age × Number of boys

**Calculation:**

Initial sum of ages = 25 × 20 = 500 years

After the boy aged 15 years leaves, the new sum of ages = 500 - 15 = 485 years

The new average is 27 years (since the average increased by 2 years), and the number of boys remains 20.

New sum of ages = 27 × 20 = 540 years

⇒ The age of the new boy = 540 - 485 = 55 years

**∴ The age of the new boy is 55 years.**

questions.question: If the average of p numbers is q² and that of q numbers is p², then the average of (p + q) numbers is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of p numbers = q²

The average of q numbers = p²

**Formula Used:**

Average of (p + q) numbers = (Sum of p numbers + Sum of q numbers) / (p + q)

**Calculation:**

Sum of p numbers = p × q²

Sum of q numbers = q × p²

Total Sum = p × q² + q × p²

Total numbers = p + q

Average of (p + q) numbers = (p × q² + q × p²) / (p + q)

Average of (p + q) numbers = pq(p + q) / (p + q)

Average of (p + q) numbers = pq

**The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: Out of his total salary, a person invests 30 percent in a scheme. If his savings is Rs.270 more than the amount in scheme and remaining amount of salary which is 25 percent, he spends, then what is the salary of a person?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Out of his total salary, a person invests 30 percent in a scheme.

If his savings is Rs.270 more than the amount in scheme and remaining amount of salary which is 25 percent, he spends.

**Calculation:**

Let 'S' and 'E' be the saving and spending respectively.

Let the salary of the person = 100x

Amount invested in scheme = 30% of 100x = 30x

Saving, S = 30x + 270

Expenditure = 25% of 100x = 25x

Now, 

Salary = Invested in scheme + Saving + Expenditure

⇒ 100x = 30x + 30x + 270 + 25x

⇒ 15x = 270

⇒ x = 18

The salary of the person = 100 × 18 = Rs. 1800

**Therefore, "Rs. 1800" is the required answer.**

questions.question: A and B can complete a work alone in 20 days and 60 days respectively. They began the work together but A left the work after some days and B completed the remaining work in 12 days. After how many days from the beginning A left the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(20, 60) = 60 units.

Efficiency: A = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/day, B = 60 ÷ 60 = 1 unit/day.

Work done by B alone in the last 12 days = 12 × 1 = 12 units.

Remaining work done by A and B together from the beginning = 60 − 12 = 48 units.

Days A and B worked together = 48 ÷ (3 + 1) = 12 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A alone to complete the work = 20 days

Time taken by B alone to complete the work = 60 days

Time taken by B to complete the remaining work = 12 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time Taken

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 20
 60
 3
 
 

 B
 60
 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work completed by B alone in the last 12 days = Efficiency of B × Days = 1 × 12 = 12 units

⇒ Remaining work to be completed by A and B together = Total Work − Work done by B

⇒ Remaining work = 60 − 12 = 48 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of A and B = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Number of days A and B worked together initially = Remaining work ÷ Combined efficiency

⇒ Days A and B worked together = 48 ÷ 4 = 12 days

This means A worked for 12 days from the beginning before leaving the work.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work & Efficiency Trick

Total work is universally taken as the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of individual completion times. Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Alternate Days Working

When individuals work on alternate days, calculate the work done in a complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 persons) and scale it up to reach the closest multiple near the total work.

Work & Wages Distribution

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the total units of work completed by each individual. If they work for the same duration, wages are directly distributed based on their efficiencies.

questions.question: The traffic lights at two different road crossings change after every 54 sec and 76 sec, respectively. If they change simultaneously at 10:15:00 hours, then find the time at which they will change again simultaneously.
questions.solution:
**Given**

The time period of first light = 54 seconds

The time period of the second light = 76 seconds

**Concept:**

Two events with different periods will coincide again after a time equal to the least common multiple (LCM) of their periods.

**Solution:**

⇒ LCM of 54 and 76 = 2052 seconds = 34 minutes 12 second

⇒ Add this to the start time of 10:15:00 + 00:34:12

**Therefore, the lights will change again simultaneously at 10:49:12.**

**Statements:**

Some laptops are computers.

No computer is a robot.

Some robots are humans.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All humans can never be computers.

(II) Some robots are laptops

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a886a1b66e714dd874afde119dbcdbce1e8010b9d83b0783b79c169cc1d8952.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All humans can never be computers → Follow (As no computer is a robot and some robots are humans. As some part of humans is common with robots which can not be computers, therefore, whole humans can not be computers.)

II. Some robots are laptops → Does not follow (As some laptops are computers and no computer is a robot. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**"

questions.question: In certain code language, BAD is written as "7" and SAP is written as "9". How is "BAN" written in that code language?
questions.solution:
"BAD" is written as "7" and "SAP" is written as "9"

With reference to English alphabet,

B = 2; A = 1; D = 4

⇒ BAD = B + A + D = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7

S = 19; A = 1; P = 16

⇒ SAP = S + A + P = 19 + 1 + 16 = 36 = 3 + 6 = 9

Similarly,

B = 2; A = 1; N = 14

⇒ BAN = B + A + N = 2 + 1 + 14 = 17 = 1 + 7 = 8

In the given code language BAN is coded as 8.
